title.narrative: Operation of the Artificial Limbs and Rehabilitation Center in Taiz Governorate 6

description.narrative: Providing physical rehabilitation services for people with special needs, following up on them and benefiting from them in serving the community, diagnosing and determining the treatment plan for each patient individually, installing all types of prosthetic limbs, providing functional rehabilitation services for prosthetic limbs and following up on them continuously, raising the capabilities of the medical and technical staff professionally and scientifically and preparing them to deal with specific cases, reducing the migration of specialized medical and technical staff

Providing physical rehabilitation services for people with special needs, following up on them, and benefiting from them in serving the community, diagnosing and determining the treatment plan for each patient individually, installing all types of prosthetic limbs, providing functional rehabilitation services for prosthetic limbs, and continuously following up on them, raising the capabilities of the medical and technical staff professionally and scientifically, preparing them to deal with specific cases, reducing the migration of specialized medical and technical staff in localizing and improving prosthetic limb and rehabilitation services, helping people with special needs to integrate into social life, maintaining their continued performance within the elements of civil society, and raising the capabilities of workers at the Prosthetic Limbs Center with the latest medical sciences.

Providing the needs for manufacturing and installing (450) new limbs and rehabilitation, follow-up and repair supplies for (2850) injured and sick people, providing the center’s services to (3300) beneficiaries, enabling (60) medical, technical, administrative and assistant staff to take jobs at the center, reducing the migration of specialized staff, raising their capabilities locally, improving performance and accommodating
